tips.title: Airbrushing Vallejo Model Air — The 2:1 Ratio
tips.text: Vallejo Model Air is thinner than Model Color and requires thinning for airbrushing. Mix at a 2:1 ratio with Vallejo Airbrush Thinner. Add 2-3 drops of Vallejo Flow Improver per 10 drops of thinned paint to ensure smooth flow. Spray at 1.5-2.0 bar pressure. Test on a white plastic spoon — if the paint spiders outward, reduce pressure; if it splatters, add more thinner.

tips.title: Base Coat Technique with Tamiya Acrylics
tips.text: For base coats, use Tamiya Acrylics diluted with Tamiya Acrylic Thinner at a 3:1 ratio. Stir well and filter through a fine mesh strainer. Apply 2-3 light coats, allowing each to dry for 5-10 minutes. Start with a light coat to avoid obscuring panel lines and details. Use a badger 150 airbrush at 15-20 psi.

tips.title: Camouflage Masking with Mr. Hobby Tape
tips.text: For complex camouflage patterns, use Mr. Hobby Masking Tape. Cut strips to match panel lines and shapes, pressing firmly to ensure a good seal. Apply a light coat of Vallejo Model Color (diluted 1:1 with Vallejo Airbrush Thinner) as a primer. This helps seal the model and improves paint adhesion. Allow to dry thoroughly before applying topcoats.

tips.title: Applying AK Interactive Washes — The Wet Method
tips.text: For a subtle effect, apply AK Interactive Washes using the 'wet' method. Dilute the wash with distilled water at a 1:3 ratio. Using a fine brush, apply the wash to panel lines, crevices, and other recessed areas while the model is still wet from a light spray of Vallejo Airbrush Thinner. Wipe off excess with a damp cloth or cotton swab. Allow to dry thoroughly before handling.

tips.title: Streaking with Oil Paints — The 'Wet-on-Wet' Technique
tips.text: To create realistic streaks, use the 'wet-on-wet' technique with oil paints. Dilute oil paints with odorless mineral spirits at a 1:1 ratio. Apply thin lines of oil paint to the model where streaks would naturally occur. While the paint is still wet, gently blend with a soft brush or cloth, allowing some streaks to remain visible. Allow to dry completely before applying a flat coat.
